No early interaction against their creature clock. Four lands with only late-game spells (Kaito, Enduring Curiosity, Sheoldred) leaves me vulnerable on turns 2-3 when they'll have 2/2 or 3/3 attackers. Control needs Cut Down, Bat, or interactive creatures early; this hand is all delayed win conditions.

Kaito is the slowest card here—4 mana with a complex setup. I need to keep Deep-Cavern Bat (turn-1 play and hand disruption), both Anoints (early removal against their 2/2s and 3/3s), Swamp (critical mana), Island, and Enduring Curiosity (Flash lets me cast it as a combat trick).
